environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB. A WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not BLOCK) to allow long department names, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-geo-restrict' that blocks non-US source IPs with priority 50, and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 100 with all rules in default action (BLOCK) and no overrides. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm SQLi rule group evaluates on all requests passing prior rules. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to a SIEM with a 15-minute alert on 403 responses, though this is observability only.

waf_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
waf_rules.action: none (use rule actions - all BLOCK by default)

config.auth: OIDC via ALB with X-Authenticated-User header injection
config.observability: ALB access logs -> S3 -> SIEM with 403 alerting (15min SLA)
